Covering 24.72 crore students, the data suggests the system is strengthening conditions for retention. The report provides a comprehensive picture of the current national school education landscape.

stories.title: Himachal Pradesh CM announces new CBSE school
stories.summary: Chief Minister Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu announced that a CBSE school will open in Mehla village starting next academic session. The announcement followed a village visit intended to gain insight into local challenges. The locals welcomed the Chief Minister with traditional attire and folk music.

stories.title: High court questions CBSE on private school curriculum
stories.summary: The Telangana High Court has asked the CBSE to explain its response to allegations that private schools force students to buy non-NCERT materials at high prices. The court is also reviewing the implementation of mandatory parent-teacher associations. The matter is set for further hearing on 12 November.

stories.title: District 5 hosts magnet and school choice fairs
stories.summary: Lexington-Richland School District Five is hosting two fairs to showcase its academic and career programs. For the first time, every school in the district will be represented. Families can speak with representatives about magnet curricula, dual enrollment and flexible learning opportunities available within the district.

stories.title: Gurpreet Singh dropped from India squad
stories.summary: Goalkeeper Gurpreet Singh Sandhu has been omitted from the 23-member squad for the upcoming friendly series against New Zealand. Head coach Khalid Jamil made the selection following a 0-4 defeat against Brazil in October. The team will now rely on three other goalkeeping options.

stories.title: India introduces Academic Bank of Credits and APAAR
stories.summary: The Ministry of Education has launched the Academic Bank of Credits to store and transfer student credits. The system links to a 12-digit APAAR identification number under the One Nation, One Student ID initiative. It is designed to support the lifelong learning journey of every student.

stories.title: Telangana HC pressures CBSE over textbook costs
stories.summary: The Telangana High Court questioned the CBSE regarding complaints that private schools force parents to purchase expensive, non-NCERT textbooks. Justice Natcharaju Venkata Shravan Kumar is hearing the petition filed by a local government employee. The court is seeking clarification on the board's enforcement actions.

stories.title: Jharkhand High Court reinstates JSSC-CGL exam results
stories.summary: The Jharkhand High Court quashed the state government decision to cancel the JSSC-CGL exam and ordered the reinstatement of selected candidates. The court directed that their service be treated as continuous. The government had previously canceled the results following a CID investigation and widespread protests by candidates.

stories.title: Telangana High Court questions CBSE on textbook mandates
stories.summary: The Telangana High Court has questioned the CBSE regarding its failure to act on complaints that affiliated schools force parents to buy non-NCERT textbooks. The petition alleges that schools impose unauthorized curricula and charge high fees. The board has been asked to explain its oversight of these practices.

stories.title: Pune to open eight CBSE-affiliated civic schools
stories.summary: The Pune Municipal Corporation received a no-objection certificate from the Maharashtra government to launch eight CBSE-affiliated schools starting in the 2027-28 academic year. The project aims to provide English-medium education to 17,000 students. The city will now operate within the central board framework for these specific locations.

stories.title: Bihar bans social media reels in government schools
stories.summary: The Bihar government has banned teachers and students from filming or uploading social media reels without official permission. This follows the recent introduction of a formal dress code for all staff. The state manages 76,000 government schools and 6.6 lakh teachers. The curriculum now includes content moderation.
